name: Creative Writing
overview: Creative writing is an art form that allows individuals to express their imagination, thoughts, and emotions through various literary genres. It encompasses storytelling, poetry, fiction, non-fiction, and playwriting. The field encourages writers to develop unique voices while mastering character development, plot construction, and literary techniques like symbolism and metaphor.
